dataset_name: Dual-Zone Agrivoltaic Field Sensor Dataset: Open-Field and PV-Shaded Microclimate Telemetry

zenodo_metadata_fields.title: Dual-Zone Agrivoltaic Field Sensor Dataset: Open-Field and PV-Shaded Microclimate Telemetry
zenodo_metadata_fields.description: Real-world dual-zone agrivoltaic microclimate telemetry collected from July 22 to August 22, 2026 for Cowpea (Vigna unguiculata). Includes 32 daily SD CSVs per zone, 5-min analytical Parquet datasets, transformation scripts, and SHA-256 integrity hashes.
